verbatim: 随机对照试验用 RoB 2 评估偏倚风险
whyItIsWrong: The method section promises a bias tool and no result or discussion paragraph ever applies it to a named study. A tool name is a commitment, not a credential; stating it without a rating reads as rigour the report does not have.
note: Same run also declared ROBINS-I and AGREE II this way. Three tools, one behaviour — a fix has to see the behaviour, not the three names.
